spans.text: Participants were eligible if they: 1) Met diagnostic criteria for alcohol abuse or dependence (assessed via the Structured Clinical Interview for Diagnosis for DSM-IV); 2) Did not meet criteria for any other Axis I disorder, except nicotine dependence; 3) Consumed ≥25 drinks/week for men and ≥20 drinks/week for women; 4) Consumed alcohol on ≥4 days/week; and 5) Could understand and consent to study procedures.

Participants were excluded if they: 1) Had contraindications for MRI (e.g., pregnancy, metallic implants); 2) Reported currently taking centrally-active medications; 3) Tested positive for psychoactive drugs (cocaine, opiates, methamphetamine, amphetamine, PCP, or benzodiazepines) as indicated by urinalysis; or 4) Provided false information during screening.
